$comment: Reference data used by the installation calculation engine. Every value carries its source. Values are DEFAULTS that a project may override; they are not a claim of compliance. Verify against the edition of the standard that applies to your jurisdiction (including Iraqi / Kurdistan Region requirements) before relying on any result.

Cu.source: IEC 60028:1925 International standard of resistance for copper (annealed copper, 1/58 ohm*mm2/m at 20 C)

Al.source: IEC 60889 hard-drawn aluminium wire (61.0 % IACS), commonly tabulated value

nominalCrossSections.source: IEC 60228 nominal cross-sectional areas of conductors

mcbRatedCurrents.source: IEC 60898-1 clause 5.3.2 preferred values of rated current

voltageDropLimits.source: IEC 60364-5-52 Annex G, Table G.52.1, installation type A (supplied directly from a public LV distribution system). Informative annex: national rules may differ.

ampacityTable.source: NOT PROVIDED. Current-carrying capacity depends on installation method, grouping and ambient temperature (IEC 60364-5-52 Annex B). No table is shipped so that no value is invented. Add rows in Project > Engineering settings from the edition of the standard you are designing to; until then the Iz <= In check is reported as 'Not evaluated'.

voltageDropMethod.formula: u = b * (rho1 * L / S * cos(phi) + lambda * L * sin(phi)) * Ib ;  dU% = 100 * u / U0
voltageDropMethod.source: IEC 60364-5-52 Annex G (informative), clause G.52.2: rho1 = 1.25 x resistivity at 20 C, lambda = 0.08 mOhm/m when no other data is available.

minimumCrossSection.source: IEC 60364-5-52 Table 52.2 (fixed installations, cables with copper conductors, power and lighting circuits). Aluminium minimum not encoded: check the applicable edition.

rcdAdditionalProtection.source: IEC 60364-4-41 clause 411.3.3 (additional protection for socket-outlets used by ordinary persons; the rated-current limit and permitted exceptions depend on the edition and national rules).

mcbInstantaneousTripMultiple.description: Upper limit of the instantaneous tripping range as a multiple of In (current that ensures magnetic tripping).
mcbInstantaneousTripMultiple.source: IEC 60898-1 Table 7 (instantaneous tripping ranges: B 3-5 In, C 5-10 In, D 10-20 In)

faultProtection.source: IEC 60364-4-41 clauses 411.4.4 (TN) and 411.5.3 (TT). Ia taken as the instantaneous-trip current, which disconnects within the Table 41.1 times. Zs uses conductor resistance at normal service temperature (1.25 x rho20) and adds Ze arithmetically (conservative).
